description: Inspect a Solana wallet's SOL balance, SPL token holdings with USD valuations, and up to 10 recent transaction signatures. Pass base58 `wallet` address (required) and optional `limit` (1-50 tokens, default 20). Returns `sol_balance`, `total_usd`, `tokens[]`, and `recent_signatures[]`. Do not use for single-token security audits (use check_solana_token_risk). 1 free try per IP, then HTTP 402 ($0.002 USDC).

session_token.description: Optional prepaid x402s_... session token from open_agent_session or https://apix402data.com/pay used after the 1 free try rolls over to HTTP 402.

name: get_solana_wallet_holdings
title: Solana wallet SOL + SPL portfolio
